item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Federal investigators probe suspicious mailings sent to state election officials and lawmakers
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

The FBI and federal authorities launched a multi-state investigation into suspicious envelopes containing unknown powdery substances mailed to election offices and congressional representatives ahead of upcoming early voting. [1] [2]

Sources: [1] [2]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

The Federal Trade Commission formally demanded testing records and safety incident disclosures from leading AI developers, escalating federal scrutiny over commercial model risks and automated decision-making. [1] [3]

Sources: [1] [3]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Sources: [1] [4]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Round Rock ISD appoints veteran police leader Mike Harmon as new district police chief
item.description:

Sources: [5] [6]

Austin city officials and UT announced a donation-backed framework to maintain the 141-acre Lions Municipal Golf Course—a historic civil rights landmark—as a permanent 18-hole public recreation space while releasing adjacent parcels for university development. [7] [8]

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Inference economics transform as Google, OpenAI, and MiniMax slash frontier API pricing
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Google made Gemini 4 Argon GA with a 1M context window at $2 input / $10 output per million tokens (matching OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol), while Shanghai startup MiniMax unveiled M3 with sparse attention at $0.30/1M input, reducing long-context compute costs to 1/20th of standard transformers. [18] [19] [20]

Sources: [18] [19] [20]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Open-weight on-device reasoning expands with Liquid AI's LFM2.5 and Mistral Large 4 previews
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Liquid AI launched the LFM2.5-24B-A2B architecture (activating 2B parameters per token at 184 tok/s on Apple Silicon for low-cost local tool-calling), as Mistral AI and Reflection AI readied open-weight releases designed to rival closed frontier models. [21] [22]

Sources: [21] [22]

item.title: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs: Adoption of lightweight 'System One' decision routers surges across agent architectures
item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

Cloudflare released open-weight Clef (27B) and Clef-flash (9B) typed probability models on Workers AI with sub-40ms latency, following TypeSafe's Jev engine ($0.042/1M input) as developers increasingly decouple high-cost reasoning from deterministic routing. [19] [23]

Sources: [19] [23]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Tech workforce reductions: Netflix, Amazon, and Airtable eliminate thousands of corporate roles amid AI capital shift

Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Netflix cut 1,000 employees (~6% of global headcount) across product, engineering, and legal units in its sharpest reduction since 2022, while Amazon trimmed under 1,000 corporate positions in its retail stores division and Bending Spoons downsized Airtable's team as tech firms aggressively reallocate operating budgets toward AI infrastructure. [24] [25]

Sources: [24] [25]

item.description:
